# VaVoirAilleurs

GPS location tweak for jailbroken iPhones.

- Fixed GPS location
- Autonomous fake routes
- Rootless jailbreak compatible
- Requires Tweak Injection
- Does not work on non-jailbroken iPhones

## Requirements

- Jailbroken iPhone
- Sileo
- Tweak Injection enabled

Install VaVoirAilleurs and respring your device.
